command:
import os, tempfile, json
directory = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='r23-link-kind-', dir='/var/tmp')
link = directory + '/dangling'
os.symlink('missing', link)
result = dict(directory=directory, target=os.readlink(link))
try:
    descriptor = os.open(link, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
    os.close(descriptor)
    result['open'] = 'ok'
except OSError as error:
    result['errno'] = error.errno
print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
